$comment: Entries in this file exempt a bench metric from the headroom check in `$cargo run -p benches -- --check`. Every entry MUST include a `reason` string and an `issue` link tracking the work to remove the exception. Entries without both fields are rejected by the checker.

allow.name: dex_aggregator.swap_best.hops_2
allow.reason: Aggregator swap_best over 2 hops is at ~%86 of the per-transaction instruction limit; the max_hops bound and path-search cost reduction are tracked in the aggregator hardening issue. This entry is allowed until that lands.

allow.name: dex_aggregator.swap_best.hops_3
allow.reason: Same as the hops_2 entry: the aggregator currently has no max_hops cap, so this size exceeds the headroom threshold by design. Tracked by the aggregator hardening issue.

allow.name: router.swap_exact_in.hops_3
allow.reason: Router has no path-length cap; a three-hop path is at ~35% of the limit and the slope is ~11.7M per hop. The path-length cap is tracked in the router path-length issue.
